en.headline: Lei Yue Mun public toilet wins gold in 2026 Best Public Toilet Awards
en.dek: The Hong Kong Toilet Association named the rebuilt Ling Nam Sun Tsuen facility in Kwun Tong the top toilet, citing its modern design and smart monitoring systems ahead of World Toilet Day.
body: The Hong Kong Toilet Association announced on Wednesday that the rebuilt public toilet at Ling Nam Sun Tsuen in Lei Yue Mun has won the gold award in its 2026 Hong Kong Best Public Toilet Election.

The association described the Kwun Tong facility, which cost about HK$38.3 million to rebuild, as a high-standard “six-star” toilet. It features extensive use of aluminium alloy materials, air-conditioning, and smart systems including safety monitoring devices in accessible washrooms that alert staff if a user shows no movement for more than 10 minutes.

Silver went to the Kowloon Park (Maze) Public Toilet, which incorporates martial-arts theme elements, and bronze to the Aberdeen Main Road Public Toilet. The association also listed three facilities needing urgent improvement: the Tung Chau Street Public Toilet in Sham Shui Po, the Tai Kiu Tsuen Public Toilet in Yuen Long, and the Chai Wan Kok Public Toilet in Tsuen Wan.

zh.headline: 鯉魚門嶺南新村公廁奪得2026最佳公廁金獎
zh.dek: 香港廁所協會周三公布結果，觀塘鯉魚門重建公廁憑現代設計及智慧監測系統獲金，適逢世界廁所日。
body: 香港廁所協會周三公布「2026香港最佳公廁選舉」結果，鯉魚門（嶺南新村）公廁奪得金獎。
協會形容這所造價約3830萬元的觀塘設施為「六星級」公廁，大量使用鋁合金材料，設空調，並裝有智慧系統，包括暢通易達洗手間內的安全監測裝置，若用戶超過10分鐘無活動跡象便會提醒職員。
銀獎為九龍公園（迷宮）公廁，融入功夫主題；銅獎為香港仔大道公廁。協會亦點名三所急待改善的廁所：深水埗通州街公廁、元朗大橋村公廁及荃灣柴灣角公廁。
